carlesso16.ref: Carlesso, Bassi, Falferi & Vinante, "Experimental bounds on collapse models from gravitational wave detectors", PRD 94, 124036 (2016), arXiv:1606.04581
carlesso16.quote: Eq. (11): "S_FF(w) = hbar^2 lam rC^3/(2 pi^{3/2} m0^2) Int dk |mu(k)|^2 |1 - e^{i a kx}|^2 kx^2 e^{-rC^2 k^2}" ; Eq. (12b): "S^LISA_FF(w) = 16 hbar^2 lam m^2/(L^2 m0^2) (rC/L)^4 (1 - e^{-L^2/4rC^2} + fcorr) (1 - e^{-L^2/4rC^2} - sqrt(pi) L/(2rC) erf(L/2rC))^2" (relative force F_rel = (F1-F2)/2 of two cubes; single cube = 2x this with fcorr = 0)
